description.narrative: To promote an effective nuclear safety culture, through the implementation of the highest level of nuclear safety and radiation protection standards, the responsible management of radioactive material, its safe storage, transport, and final disposal, and to ensure the safeguarding of radioactive materials throughout the remediation lifecycle. title.narrative: To promote an effective nuclear safety culture

description.narrative: To promote an effective nuclear safety culture, through the implementation of the highest level of nuclear safety and radiation protection standards, the responsible management of radioactive waste, its safe storage, transport, and final disposal, and to ensure the safeguarding of radioactive materials throughout the remediation lifecycle.

title.narrative: Radiation levels

description.narrative: Reference levels of radiation safety at the site achieved and maintained throughout the remediation programme.

comment.narrative: Baseline Radiation Controlled Areas around contaminated buildings and land areas constructed 2021Estimated 410m3 of easy to move and free standing radioactive contaminated materials scattered around the South Area of PChP Site 2021.Building 2B owned by DZMU with hot spots of c 2mSvhr. background radiation not controlled 2021Area adjacent to the Zavodska railway station also owned by DZMU has unknown volumes of radiologically contaminated ground and circ 500 meters of railway line with significant surface contamination 2021. Three areas with significant volumes of contaminated ground located in the North part of the PChP site 2021

All buildings and land areas outside the Radiation Controlled Areas in both the South and North Areas of the PChP Site meet the required reference levels of radiation safety 2025. As a provisional target a level of maximum 1 mSvhr is considered in any place of the site covered by the project.
